summary: Frontend-only testing of new Design System living style-guide page (/app/design-system) + regression on CompanyAdmin / Resident / Security dashboards. Design System page renders perfectly with ALL required testIds (root, hero, 6 nav chips, 6 PageHeader themes, 2 stat variants with 9 cards each, 2 SectionCards, 2 EmptyStates, clickable stat). Clickable stat fires alert as expected. All 3 regression dashboards render correctly after login + account selection + Continue button on /select-account.
critical_code_review_comments: DesignSystemPage.js uses Tailwind dynamic class names via template strings (e.g., `bg-${color}-100 text-${color}-700 border border-${color}-200` in Tag component). In JIT mode this only works if those classes are already generated elsewhere in the codebase. If a Tag color is used that is not present in any other file, the styles will silently break at production build time. Consider adding a safelist in tailwind.config.js or using a static color map.

Route `/app/design-system` is accessible to ANY authenticated user (no role gate). This is intentional per the agent note, but a comment/guard acknowledging developer-facing exposure in production would be cleaner; consider wrapping in a role check (app_owner/super_admin only) before shipping to prod.
Footer text hard-codes 'آخر تحديث مايو 2026' — will go stale; move to a constant or derive from build metadata.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow requires TWO steps: (1) submit username+password at /login → redirects to /select-account, (2) click first [data-testid^=account-card-] THEN click the 'متابعة' (continue) button → redirects to /app/dashboard. Simply clicking the account card is NOT enough; the Continue button must be clicked. AppVersionGuard may auto-reload ~once on first visit to /app/* routes; add 5-7s wait after navigation. Design System route `/app/design-system` renders standalone (no role gate) and all testids verified in iter64.
